subject: Invitation link failing during account claim - hash/redirect mismatch
messages:
From: Alice Chen <alice@sunveil.com>
To: Rafael Mendes <rafael_mendes@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 18 Jun 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Trouble claiming supplier invite - keeps redirecting to /claim?hash=INVALID

Hi Rafael,

We received the supplier invite link yesterday and when I try to claim the account it immediately redirects to a page that shows 'Claim failed - invalid token'. The URL shows a different hash than the one in the email (it ends with ?hash=0000XXXX). I tried in Chrome and Safari, cleared cookies, tried incognito, and it still fails.

Attached is a screenshot of the browser (screenshot-login-error.png). We have a PO outstanding and need to confirm billing details — our AP team is blocked. Can you escalate?

Thanks,
Alice Chen

Hi Alice — thanks for the quick report and sorry for the friction.

Quick asks so we can triage:
- Can you paste the full invite link you received (feel free to redact tokens)
- Confirm the email you used to claim (should match the invite)
- Any proxy/VPN in use? Corporate network?

I’ve looped in Ben from onboarding operations to validate the invite record and scope an expedited fix. We’ll also pull server logs for the redirect you saw.

If it helps, the temporary workaround is to request a fresh invite from me — I can reissue a one-time link that uses an alternate claim flow. Would you like me to do that now?

— Rafael
Rafael Mendes
Senior Manager, Procurement Integrations
Redwood Inference
rafael_mendes@redwood.com
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Rafael Mendes <rafael_mendes@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 18 Jun 2028 11:32:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Trouble claiming supplier invite - keeps redirecting to /claim?hash=INVALID

Rafael — I pulled the invite records for the Sunveil account (account id 87c2f). The invite was generated at 2028-06-17T16:02Z with token hash 7f4b2a. The claim endpoint is returning a 302 to /claim?hash=0000XXXX for some requests — this looks like our legacy alias-normalization middleware swapping out the token when an email alias mapping exists.

I’ve attached a short capture of the server-side support log extract (support-log.txt) showing the redirect and the alias-normalization lookup that ran. Neha, can you ask runtime infra to confirm whether the normalization hook executed for requests from the east-us edge cluster today? If so, we need an immediate hotfix to skip normalization for invite-claim endpoints.

For now, Rafael — please issue the fresh invite I mentioned, but set it to the 'bypass-normalization' flag. Alice: I can generate it and send you a short-lived link (expires 24h).

Ben Carter
Onboarding Ops
ben_carter@redwood.com
From: Alice Chen <alice@sunveil.com>
To: Rafael Mendes <rafael_mendes@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 19 Jun 2028 15:42:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Trouble claiming supplier invite - keeps redirecting to /claim?hash=INVALID

Thanks Rafael and Ben — the fresh invite worked right away when I used the bypass link. I was able to complete the claim, submit tax forms, and confirm the PO routing.

A couple notes for your postmortem:
- The original invite email showed a long token; after clicking it the URL quickly changed to /claim?hash=0000XXXX before the error page rendered.
- Our security team noted that some corporate proxies will rewrite querystrings under certain conditions; could that have interacted with alias-normalization?

If you want, I can forward the screenshot and our internal proxy rule snippet — happy to help reproduce.

Appreciate the quick turnaround.

Best,
Alice
